newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BENKENSTEIN LEADS NATAL RECOVERY VS BORDER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BENKENSTEIN LEADS NATAL RECOVERY VS BORDER.

text.p: New captain Dale Benkenstein engineered a confident batting recovery by Natal against Border with an unbeaten 129 on the opening day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match at Kingsmead on Friday.
Reeling at 22 for three midway through the morning session on a pitch offering pace and bounce, Natal reached a promising 315 for five in their first innings by the close.

Benkenstein, 22, posted his highest score for Natal in South Africa's premier domestic competition and his third century at first-class level, striking 16 fours, a towering six off slow left-armer Ian Howell in five and a half hours at the crease.

He was given solid support by Mark Bruyns (73) during a fifth-wicket stand of 136 in 39 overs. Bruyns was particularly punishing off the back foot and had powered 12 fours before he was found leg before wicket to the pace of West Indian Vasbert Drakes.
Shaun Pollock, playing his first match of the season for Natal, then joined his captain and struck a fluent 59 not out.
Drakes, 26, played his first season of English county cricket for Sussex earlier in the year and on Friday was spearhead of the Border attack, making the ball swing early.
Bowling with hostility and generally impressive control on a good Kingsmead pitch, Drakes finished the day with deserved figures of 3-52.
